name: Holding a request to a measure
vision_statement: Every request is held to a measure until its goal is met.
opportunities: Translating a request into a metric, creating and editing the specs and metrics, judging goal completion, replanning an unmet goal and judging response quality and checking a draft decision with independent views are six ML tasks, each improvable on its own accuracy. Judging a request separately for each solution it concerns is a seventh task, improvable on whether the record that decides a case reaches the right pass.
solution_coherence: Critical Thinking holds a request to a measure. Metric Translation turns the request into a metric with a target value or improvement and a budget, adjustable while the work runs. ESOI Application records that metric as a spec and applies the principles, creating and editing specs and metrics. Goal Completion says whether the goal's condition was met against its done-standard, and whether iteration the person did not ask for should go on (continue, stop when met, stop when good enough or not worth its cost, or ask the person), within what the person stated and the policy that bounds it. When it was not, the composition's pursue step uses the untried read-only means within a budget before the response is sent, says once that the rest is still being worked on when the work is long, and otherwise reports what was tried and what is missing. Response Quality judges the response against the quality profile resolved for the request. Decision Check tests a draft decision (a pick among options, or a reply) with small independent checks that each see only their own evidence and run in parallel: where they agree the draft stands, where they disagree one call decides from quoted evidence or the check abstains, and only a failing part of a reply is repaired; the mistakes it finds become known-mistake lines that the checks carry only while their metric says they pay. Metric Upkeep keeps a milestone's metrics able to show progress: it decides each metric's state from its fields and reads what it can. When the milestone's own metric moves only through a person, Metric Upkeep first has an intermediate metric the AI can move proposed, then relies on Decision Check to agree that this metric tracks the done test, and on ESOI Application to write it. The composition's progress step runs Metric Upkeep, picks the first rung of the increment ladder that applies, measures it before, does it, has pursue refuse a result that is bookkeeping alone, and measures it after with a check that is not the writer. Solution Passes gives each solution the request concerns its own cheap pass on the prompt its records form, then a narrower pass for each scope above until one finds no effect on how its children combine, and a narrow pass for each solution relying on it. The targets those passes read from each solution's own metric are what the goal is held to, piece by piece, and what the passes and the checks taught is recorded for the next request. Structure in Conversation decides what structure a reply to a person carries: from the move the turn calls for it shows the problem, ideal, solution, alternatives, metric and milestone the records already hold, proposes only what is missing, and makes at most one offer that ESOI Application later applies as ensure-one additions, so a plain turn stays plain and what a reply proposes is built on in the next conversation.
